reserveReview.rationale: Lifecycle proposal reviewed 2026-11-12: retain active monitoring with a material conversion-halt notice and recovery hold; containment is documented, but effective termination of DLLR is not established. On 2026-11-07T20:05:28Z, SIP-0097 replaced the Zero financial implementations, including ZUSD, with ZeroEmergencyHalt. At Rootstock block 9406049 (2026-11-12T14:45:55Z; hash 0x18cb950a1cfa34f6e54a79f2be3d128f171178cfb0fd66963570451fda7af157), getImplementation() still returns 0xe0E757E8fcf336658036202834aEE10ce03debDA and balanceOf(Mynt MassetManager 0x5f777270259e32f79589fe82269db6209f7b7582) reverts with Zero: emergency shutdown. The proxy uses a custom implementation getter, not EIP-1967. Both Mynt redeem(1 DLLR) calls, selecting DOC or ZUSD, also revert at that pin. The accessible 120,624.718465306245685181 DOC holding is not a working redemption leg or a measured share of the current book. Editorial choice: replace the current fallback with 100% unavailable exposure instead of carrying historical weights into a now-unreadable denominator. Historical evidence retained here only: block 9167786 on 2026-08-20 read 1,809,205.3931645737 ZUSD and 428.1826685298049 DOC, or 99.976338709% and 0.023661291%. The historical ZUSD position is now a halted token claim; these weights do not measure current holdings, recoverable value or holder loss. The recovery manifest describes precautionary containment and qualified restoration conditions, not a DLLR wind-down. No asset-lifecycle freeze, live-reader suspension or numeric loss estimate is asserted.
